senses.gloss: to sit down, rest; to dwell, remain; to be inactive.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Makkot 3:15">Macc. III, 15</cite> <he>כל חיוֹשֵׁב ולא עבר וכ׳</he> whoever is inactive and commits no sin, i.e. omits to do wrong; <cite ref="Kiddushin 39b:15">Kidd. 39ᵇ</cite>.—
<cite ref="Eruvin 100a:23">Erub. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>שֵׁב ואל תעשה עדיף</he> ‘sit and do nothing’, i.e. not to act in doubtful cases, is better, opp. <he>קום ועשה</he>.
<cite ref="Berakhot 20a:3">Ber. 20ᵃ</cite> <he>שב ואל תעשה שאני</he> with an omission it is different.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 7:8">Tosef. Snh. VII, 8</cite> <he>ולא יֵשְׁבוּ … להם שֵׁבוּ</he> and they must not sit down until he says to them, Be seated; <cite ref="Horayot 13b">Hor. 13ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bikkurim 3:3:9">Y. Bicc. III, 65ᶜ</cite> bot.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Demai 2:3:4">Y. Dem. II, 23ᵃ</cite> top <he>שי׳ בישיבח</he> who has a seat in the scholars’ meetings.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 10b">Snh. 10ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 2:1">Tosef. ib. II, 1</cite> <he>אחד אומר לֵישֵׁב</he> if one is in favor of sitting (holding deliberation in court).
<cite ref="Mishnah Zevachim 2:1">Zeb. II, 1</cite> <he>יוֹשֵׁב</he> in a sitting position.

<cite ref="Berakhot 28b">Ber. 28ᵇ</cite> <he>מיוֹשְׁבֵי בה״מ</he> one of the attendants at college, <he>יושבי קרנות</he> those placed at street corners (traders, idlers). Gen. R. s 75 <he>יושבי קרנות</he> (corr. <he>קרונות</he>) sitting in chariots; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 4:1">Num. R. s. 4</cite> <he>הגבעה</he> … <he>יוֹשְׁבִים</he> Gibeah and Kiryath Jearim were settled at the same time.—

<cite ref="Eruvin 86a:2">Erub. 86ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 61:8">Ps. LXI, 8</cite>) <he>אימתי יושב עולם לפני וכ׳</he> (Rashi a. Ar. <he>יֵשֵׁב</he>) when is the world settled (evenly balanced) before God? When kindness and truth are appointed to guard it (differ. in Rashi; v. infra).

senses.gloss: to settle, put in place, to arrange evenly. Y. Sabb. XII, beg. 13ᶜ הבנאי י׳ את האבן וכ׳ the builder that placed a stone on top of the row (v. דִּימוֹס I). Ib.ᵈ top; Y. Pes. VIII, 33ᵇ top מפני שהוא כמְיַישֵּׁב בידו because it is like settling the web with one’s own hand.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37">Lev. R. s. 37</cite> [read:] <he>יָשַׁב וְיִ׳ להם סבלותם וכ׳</he> he sat down (as a judge) and arranged their burdens in proper proportions between man and woman.
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 37">Ib.</cite> <he>אתה עתיד ליַישֵּׁב וכ׳</he> thou art designated to settle and explain to my children their vows &c.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 31:5">Ex. R. s. 31</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 61:8">Ps. LXI, 8</cite>, v. supra) <he>יַשֵּׁב עולמך</he> make thy world evenly balanced (as to property); Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 9">Mishp. 9</cite> <he>תיישר עולמך בשוה</he> (read: <he>תְּיַישֵּׁב</he>).
Ex. R. s. 52 לא היו יודעין ליַישְּׁבוֹ they knew not how to put its parts together; a. fr.—Trnsf. to set the mind at ease, to quiet.

<cite ref="Shabbat 87a:8">Sabb. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>דברים שמְיַישְּׁבִין לבו וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שמושכין</he>) words which quiet the mind of man &c.; <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 80">Gen. R. s. 80</cite> <he>דברים שמְיַישְּׁבִים את הלב</he>. Y. Pes. V, end, 32ᵈ (expl. <he>וישב</he>, <cite ref="II Samuel 7:18">II Sam. VII, 18</cite>) <he>וַיַישֶּׁב עצמו לתפלה</he> he quieted his mind for prayer; a. e.
<cite ref="Berakhot 58b">Ber. 58ᵇ</cite> … <he>עתיד להחזירו וליַישְּׁבוֹ</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>ליִישּׁוּבוֹ</he>) the Lord will again people it.
Sot. 22ᵃ מְיַישְּׁבֵי עולם cultivators of the world.—Part. pass. מְיוּשָּׁב, f. מְיוּשֶּׁבֶת
<cite ref="Megillah 21a:15">Meg. 21ᵃ</cite>. Y. Gitt. VII, 48ᵈ top; a. fr.—
senses.label: a

senses.gloss: sedate, at ease. Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵇ bot. לבו מי׳ his mind is at ease (about his animal); Bab.
units: <cite ref="Berakhot 30a:6">Ber. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>לפי שאין דעתו מי׳ עליו</he> because his mind is not at ease without it.
<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 131:1">Sifré Num. 131</cite> <he>היה … בקי ומי׳</he> the polemarch was experienced and cool-headed; a. fr.
senses.label: b

units: <cite ref="Yoma 38a">Yoma 38ᵃ</cite> sq.; <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 2:7">Tosef. ib. II, 7</cite> <he>במקומך יוֹשִׁיבוּךָ</he> people will finally seat thee in the place which thou deservest.

<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 6:17">Tosef. Sabb. VI</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 7:17">VII</cite>), 17 (among superstitious practices) <he>חמוֹשֶׁבֶת אפרוחים</he> (<cite ref="F00000"><he>ו</he></cite>)<he>אמרה איני מוֹשַׁבְתָּן וכ׳</he> a woman who sets hens to brood and says I will not set them except in pairs (v. ed. Zuck. note).
<cite ref="Mishnah Sanhedrin 4:4">Snh. IV, 4</cite> <he>מוֹשִׁיבִין אותו וכ׳</he> a seat is assigned to him in the third row.

<cite ref="Makkot 10a:7">Macc. 10ᵃ</cite> <he>ואין מוֹשִׁיבִין אותם וכ׳</he> and we must not lay them out except on a river; (Tosef. ib. III (II), 8 <he>בונין</he>).—Tosef. l. c. <he>מביאין … ומושיבין וכ׳</he> other people are imported and settled in their place.
<cite ref="Bava Kamma 16b">B. Kam. 16ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>הוֹשִׁיבוּ ישיבה וכ׳</he> they held scholars’ meetings by his grave.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 17a:21">Snh. 17ᵃ</cite> <he>אין מושיבין בסנהדרי וכ׳</he> none can be appointed members of the Sanhedrin except &c.; a. v. fr.

<cite ref="Pirkei DeRabbi Eliezer 43:7">Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIII</cite> <he>ארץ נוֹשֶׁבֶת</he> an inhabited land, settlement; (<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 1:15">Koh. R. to I, 15</cite> <cite ref="J00350"><he>יִישּׁוּכ</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Berakhot 31a:15">Ber. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>כל ארץ שגזר … ליישוב נִתְיַישְּׁבָה</he> every land which Adam designated for settlement, has been settled.

senses.gloss: to be at ease, to be refreshed, to come to.
units: <cite ref="Yoma 82a:9">Yoma 82ᵃ</cite> <he>אם נִתְיַשְּׁבָה דעתה</he> if she feels that her craving has been gratified.

<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">Lam. R. to I, 11</cite> (ref. to <he>להשיב נפש</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1:52">ib.</cite>) <he>עד כמה מִתְיַישֶּׁבֶת נפש</he> how much is required for one fainting from hunger (v. <he>בּוֹלִימוֹס</he>) to come to himself again?—
<cite ref="Chagigah 3b:11">Ḥag. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>לאחר שנתיישבה דעתו</he> after his excitement had subsided.

<cite ref="Eruvin 65a:19">Erub. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>כל המתיישב ביינו</he> he who remains clear-minded when drinking wine. Kinnim III, 6 <he>כל זמן … דעתם מתישבת עליהם</he> the older they grow, the more clear-minded do they become, opp. <he>מיטרפת</he>; a. fr.
